environment.description: Django 4.2 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate, connecting directly to Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15.4 instance. Database connection uses django.db.backends.postgresql with default connection settings. Application is behind an AWS ALB with no WAF attached. The sort_by parameter validation uses a split-and-check approach but the attacker can inject SQL after a valid column name (e.g., 'price; DROP TABLE products_product--' would fail the check, but 'price DESC, (SELECT pg_sleep(5))--' passes because 'price' is in allowed_sorts and the code only checks sort_by.split(' ')[0]).

config.network: ALB -> ECS Fargate -> RDS (no intermediate proxy)
